title: Insurance Claim Repairs Intake and Final Inspection Standards
content:
The intake and vehicle-ready standards of Insurance Claim Repairs differ by repair class. The two tables give every class's figure for each standard.

## At drop-off, before work

| Repair class | Walk-around photos at drop-off | Pre-repair diagnostic scan before work starts | High-voltage depower of a hybrid or electric vehicle before work |
|---|---|---|---|
| Express Claim Repair | 8 | Not required | Not required |
| Standard Claim Repair | 12 | Required | Not required |
| Major Claim Repair | 16 | Required | Required |
| Structural Claim Repair | 24 | Required | Required |
| Certified Structural Claim Repair | 24 | Required | Required |
| Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair | 32 | Required | Required |

The walk-around photos are taken at drop-off and kept with the repair order.

## Before vehicle-ready

| Repair class | Post-repair diagnostic scan | Four-wheel alignment check | Electronic structural measurement reports | Minimum road test (miles) | Final quality inspection checklist points | Check against manufacturer calibration requirements, every resulting calibration order closed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Claim Repair | Required | Not required | 0 | 3 | 12 | Required |
| Standard Claim Repair | Required | Not required | 0 | 5 | 18 | Required |
| Major Claim Repair | Required | Required | 0 | 5 | 24 | Required |
| Structural Claim Repair | Required | Required | 2 | 10 | 32 | Required |
| Certified Structural Claim Repair | Required | Required | 3 | 10 | 36 | Required |
| Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair | Required | Required | 3 | 10 | 40 | Required |

The electronic structural measurement reports are drawn from the pre-pull, post-pull and final measurements; the figure is the number of such reports the class requires.

### Points of reading

- Every class requires the post-repair scan and the calibration check; the pre-repair scan is the one scan Express Claim Repair does not require.
- The alignment check and the high-voltage depower start at Major Claim Repair and apply in every class above it.
